commonQuestions.question: Which SBA district office covers Fort Worth?
commonQuestions.answer: The SBA Dallas/Fort Worth District Office serves Fort Worth and 72 surrounding North Texas counties.

commonQuestions.question: Where can I get free SBA loan application help in Fort Worth?
commonQuestions.answer: The Tarrant County College SBDC, part of the North Texas SBDC Network, provides free business consulting and loan prep assistance.

commonQuestions.question: What is the difference between SBA 7(a) and 504 loans for Fort Worth businesses?
commonQuestions.answer: SBA 7(a) provides up to $5M for general working capital, debt refinance, or acquisitions. SBA 504 specializes in owner-occupied real estate and heavy equipment.

commonQuestions.question: Does Fund44 issue SBA loans directly in Fort Worth?
commonQuestions.answer: No. Fund44 is an educational technology marketplace, not a lender. Loans are issued by third-party SBA participating lenders.
